requirement: The application shall run in a browser with a React/Redux frontend, a Node/Express backend, and PostgreSQL for persistent application data. Operators shall be able to configure the backend API base URL, Cloudinary URL, and Cloudinary upload preset through environment settings.

Users shall be able to upload sounds, view sound lists and details, and delete sounds in supported workflows. The application shall also support avatar and sound-cover image uploads. Audio and images shall be uploaded directly from the browser to Cloudinary, with their hosted URLs and associated application records persisted in PostgreSQL through the backend.

Users shall be able to play a selected sound and seek to a position by clicking its waveform. Starting another sound shall stop or pause the previous one so only one sound remains active. Playback shall continue across supported in-app navigation and component changes without unintended interruption or reset.
Users shall be able to register, log in, and view user information through the application, with user records maintained for authentication and profile-related workflows.
Users shall be able to follow and unfollow other users. The application shall maintain these relationships and make followed users' sounds available in follow-related feeds or views.
The application shall validate user form input and present visible validation feedback or error messages during data entry and submission.
